name: Vishnuteja Ambati
tagline: Computer Engineering at Iowa State · AI systems, research & real-time engineering

paragraphs: I'm Vishnu, a Computer Engineering student at Iowa State University, where I'll also minor in AI. I transferred from BITS Pilani after two years of Computer Science.
I'm a Founding Engineer at Hivemind ↗ (opens in a new tab), building Iris, an AI portfolio-intelligence platform.
As an AI and systems engineer, I build AI that holds up in production: LLM pipelines, knowledge graphs, real-time vision, and the systems underneath them.
